tests/test_repo_content_audit.py.why: this audit's controls reintroduce retired content on purpose

tests/test_repo_inventory.py.why: the inventory's tests assert edges between baseline paths

tools/mutations/repository_content.json.why: this audit's mutation specification: two of its mutations plant retired content in the learned-model substrate on purpose, to show the boundary tests refuse it

tools/repo_content_audit.py.why: this audit: its vocabulary is what it looks for

tools/repo_inventory.py.why: the inventory's rules name the retired paths in order to classify them
